title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
  
For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.

**Quality Assurance Analyst**  
  

The SAP Test Automation Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automated test solutions using Selenium and REST APIs for SAP end-to-end (E2E) test scenarios, ensuring the delivery of high-quality software.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium and REST APIs for SAP E2E testing.
* Modify and enhance existing automation scripts based on changes in UI, business processes, and application requirements.
* Work closely with the Enterprise Business Analyst team to understand requirements and prepare the required test data.
* Develop and maintain robust, scalable, and reusable test automation frameworks.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes, automation practices, and overall software quality.
* Collaborate effectively with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams in an onsite-offshore delivery model.

### **Qualification**

* BE/ME/MCA from a reputed institute.
* Minimum 4+ years of IT experience, including at least 3 years of experience as a Test Automation Developer/Engineer.

### **Must-Have Skills & Experience**

* Strong experience in SAP Test Automation, particularly SAP Fiori-based applications using REST APIs.
* Hands-on experience in developing and implementing Selenium-based test automation suites.
* Experience in developing test automation strategies and frameworks using Selenium and REST APIs.
* Strong understanding and hands-on experience with Test Automation concepts, methodologies, and best practices.
* Hands-on experience with GitHub and version control practices.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and effectively manage requirements.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work with global counterparts.
* Ability to learn quickly and adapt to a broad spectrum of cloud-based technologies and solutions.
* Experience working in an onsite-offshore delivery model.
* Strong understanding of relevant technical and industry best practices in software testing and quality engineering.

### **Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with SAP Web GUI automation.
* Hands-on experience with Robot Framework.
* Exposure to modern test automation and quality engineering practices.

Purpose:
  

* Responsible for strategy and design of controls system (hardware, software, telecommunications, infrastructure and/or information), testing strategy, standards and practices for enterprise, major organization or major platform. May define and manage project deliverables and work with the platform Centers of Competence (architecture, infrastructure \& production support) teams ensuring adherence to processes and coherence standards. Scope:
  

General:
  

* Performs routine assignments in entry level of the professional career band

  

* Typically a graduate, although may have progressed into the role via equivalent business experience that provide knowledge and exposure to fundamental, theories, principles, and concepts

  

* Professional roles will typically require a degree in their specific discipline which may apply to specific positions.

  

* Receives instruction, guidance and direction from others

  

* Limited decision making authority guided by policies, procedures, and business operations protocol
